description: Intended-world values at each annual lookup (1 January), computed by the shared runtime intended-value rule. Current law is already fiscal-year processed; construction windows override that annual value. These are not simulation readbacks: measure-year artifacts record each world's actual processed values and refuse a mismatch, except one in an announcement world before the measure commences whose worlds come out identical, listed under processed_value_notes. Selected metadata-based construction revisions are digest-bound.
